summary.text: Cheryl Golek is a Democratic state representative from Harpswell, Maine, who has represented House District 99 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Golek lives in Harpswell, Maine, and founded The Vicarage By The Sea.
She assumed office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, succeeding MaryAnne Kinney, and in 2023 and 2024 was assigned to the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee.
Golek advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
